klausen-pragel-walensee-precision-loop.title: Klausen · Pragel · Walensee Precision Loop
klausen-pragel-walensee-precision-loop.slogan: Two passes and 240 km, high point 1950 m
klausen-pragel-walensee-precision-loop.story: Forest shade, limestone walls and a hard look at weather. 240 km round from Glarus - plan on about 4 h 35 of riding. The stops in between: Altdorf and Walensee view stop. The climbs: Klausenpass and Pragelpass high road. It tops out at about 1,950 m. Klausen Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 34 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-the-ratkov-rozhnov-a-estate-dubki.story: 344 km from Lomonosov to Lomonosov, about 5 h 56 of riding. It goes by way of The Village of Olgino, Volkhonskoe Highway, Prioratsky Park and The Blocade Ring. The line favours views over speed.
